Subject: Zero-Trust Access Handoff — SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist checkpoints

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the kickoff this morning. Per our discussion I’m sending a concise handoff with the engineering checkpoints we recommend before turning on enforcement for your tenant. Goal: enable SSO + SCIM provisioning and IP allowlist with a canary group so your security team can validate policy and roll back quickly if needed.

High-level items (see attached checklist):
- Exchange SAML metadata (I attached globex_saml_metadata.xml).
- Confirm entityID and ACS values in your IdP (Okta by your note).
- SCIM: map "engineering" and "contractors" groups to RBAC roles; see scim-group-mapping.csv.
- Service accounts: we recommend creating two ephemeral service accounts for the initial canary (one read-only, one admin for troubleshooting).
- IP allowlist: provide CIDR ranges for office egress and CI runners; we’ll stage allowlist in staging first.
- Enforcement window: propose 10/04/2026 08:00 PT for canary, full enforcement 10/11/2026 08:00 PT if no regressions.

Next actions for Globex:
1) Share IdP admin where we can upload SAML metadata and confirm ACS/entityID.
2) Provide the CIDR list for allowlisting.
3) Confirm two pilot user emails for the canary group.

Internal notes: Monica — please prepare SCIM mapping + temporary service account recipes. Neha — I’ll need the network runbook and rollback play.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_zero_trust_checklist.xlsx, globex_saml_metadata.xml

Hi Alice — attaching the SCIM mapping file (scim-group-mapping.csv) and a short walk-through below.

SCIM mapping summary:
- Globex group "engineering" -> Redwood role "developer-basic" (role_id: rwd_dev_01)
- Globex group "contractors" -> Redwood role "contractor-limited" (role_id: rwd_ctr_02)
- Email attribute: use "userName" (email) for unique id; include "displayName" and "members" arrays.

Service account guidance:
- Create two service accounts in Okta: rwd-canary-ro and rwd-canary-admin.
- rwd-canary-ro should be scoped to token:read and token:validate only.
- rwd-canary-admin will be used by your SREs during the 48-hour troubleshooting window; its keys should be rotated after the canary.

I also added a short mapping to indicate where we’ll apply Org Policies (session length, device posture checks).

Monica
